name: Lindt Chocolate Tour
overview: The Lindt Home of Chocolate in Kilchberg offers an immersive journey through chocolate history, production, and tasting. This modern facility combines museum exhibits, chocolate-making demonstrations, and unlimited tasting opportunities.
history: Lindt was founded in 1845 by David Sprüngli-Schwarz and Rudolf Sprüngli-Ammann. The company revolutionized chocolate making with the conching process invented by Rudolf Lindt in 1879, creating the smooth texture that made Swiss chocolate world-famous.
highlights: Panoramic views of Lake Zurich from café
tips: Book online for guaranteed entry. Allow 2-3 hours for full experience. Chocolate workshop requires separate booking. Café offers stunning lake views. Shop has exclusive products not available elsewhere.
